critical_code_review_comments: ProfitCalculator: when quantity input is cleared/empty, Number(quantity) becomes 0 then Math.max(1, 0)=1 — math stays safe. Good.

ProfitCalculator preset buttons can produce duplicate testids when minRetail=1 and minWholesale*1=1 (e.g. presets [1, 50, 100, 250] for p001 are unique, but for any product where minRetail equals minWholesale this would collide). Currently no collision exists in seeded data.
Profit chart Bar uses Math.max(calc.profit, 0) so loss is rendered as 0 height — acceptable, but a small caption indicating 'pertes non affichées sur le graphe' could help UX.
All product images are external Unsplash URLs — they loaded fine during testing but a placeholder fallback would harden the UI for offline/slow networks.
No backend API logic; site is pure UI demo as specified — no MongoDB/_id concerns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI flows green on first pass. Profit calculator math validated against the ground-truth example in the review request. If new products are added, ensure preset values [minRetail, minWholesale, minWholesale*2, minWholesale*5] stay unique to avoid duplicate calc-qty-preset-* testids.
